intervals.label: Y2L and KIMS experiment constructed
intervals.note: Start: the review dates the construction of Y2L and KIMS to 2003. End: first WIMP-search data in July 2004 (src:kims-first-limit-2006).
intervals.quote: we have initiated non-accelerator astroparticle physics research with the construction of Y2L and the KIMS dark matter search experiment since 2003

intervals.label: WIMP-search data taking with CsI(Tl) crystals
intervals.note: Start: first two-month data set from July 2004 (one 6.6 kg crystal). End: operation 'temporarily halted' in December 2012 to upgrade the modules (src:kims-csi-low-mass-2014). Gaps between runs are not documented.
intervals.quote: During the two-month period starting from July 2004, we have taken data for WIMP search using one crystal

intervals.label: stable running of the 12-crystal (103.4 kg) array
intervals.quote: The 12 crystals operated stably between September 2009 and December 2012.

intervals.label: completed (CsI(Tl) data taking ended)
intervals.note: The CsI(Tl) array's operation was halted in December 2012 'in order to upgrade the detector modules'; no CsI(Tl) data after 2012 appear in later KIMS papers (the 2016 axion paper uses 2009-2012 data) and the NaI(Tl) stage (KIMS-NaI) followed.
intervals.quote: In December 2012, the operation was temporarily halted in order to upgrade the detector modules.

physics_goals.quote: The KIMS (Korea Invisible Matter Search) collaboration is performing direct searches for WIMPs using CsI(Tℓ) detectors in the Yangyang Underground Laboratory (Y2L).
physics_goals.value: Direct search for WIMP dark matter with CsI(Tl) crystals; test of the DAMA signal

summary.plain: KIMS (Korea Invisible Mass Search) was an array of cesium-iodide crystals, 103.4 kg in all, deep in a tunnel at the Yangyang power plant in South Korea, built to catch dark matter particles. It saw no signal and set limits, including on regions claimed by the DAMA experiment.
summary.technical: CsI(Tl) scintillating-crystal array, 12 modules (103.4 kg) with pulse-shape discrimination of nuclear recoils, in a copper/polyethylene/lead/mineral-oil shield at Y2L (700 m overburden). 24524.3 kg d (2009-10 data): the most stringent spin-dependent WIMP-proton limits above 20 GeV/c^2 at the time; low-mass analysis rejects most of the low-mass region favoured by DAMA; 34,596 kg d solar-axion search.
